bluf: Performics is Publicis Groupe's performance marketing agency, selling search, social, programmatic and commerce media through its OneSuite platform, with offices from Chicago to India and Brazil. It is doing platform and feed work: Connected Feed launched 2025-06, a Romania expansion 2025-05, 2026 awards in Ukraine and Poland and a Saudia campaign on Uber Journey Ads. Horus reads it Neutral at -7, best placed for KJ1, most exposed to KJ6, 1 of 3 tested lines practised. A rival should know: it sells paid search and paid social while running no Google ads and no social pixel of its own, and names 3 clients behind a 1,000+ client claim.
doing:
The positioning line, Publicis Groupe's performance marketing agency using identity data, AI and its OneSuite platform to orchestrate search, social, programmatic and commerce, decodes to a holdco media operations unit sold as software. The headline claim, 3T+ data signals, 1,000+ global clients and 15,000+ performance experts across 60+ markets, is scale; the record names 3 clients.

The menu is Performance marketing, One Search, One Social, One Programmatic, One Commerce, Identity-powered planning, Measurement (MMM and attribution) and Product feed management. No capability leads; five score 2 and form the core: Paid Search (the One Search module, a Global Head of Search), Paid Social (One Social, Performics x Meta Horizon posts), Programmatic & CTV (One Programmatic, programmatic Uber Ads work for Saudia), Retail Media (One Commerce, the Connected Feed launch) and Data & Measurement (identity powered planning, OneSuite measurement blending custom MMM with digital attribution). AI automation, AI search, CRO and SEO score 1; breadth is 9. Proprietary items: OneSuite, Connected Feed and PRBA, a privacy first attribution model. Partners: Meta Horizon and Microsoft.

AI posture: OneSuite is pitched as AI powered for optimization, faster activation and predictive insight, and it publishes GEO and conversational AI search research with Microsoft, but AI search scores 1 and P1 is partial: research without an audited product. Moves in order: 2025-05, expansion into Romania; 2025-06, Connected Feed launched; 2026-07, seven IAB MIXX Awards for Performics Ukraine and an EMMA award for Performics Poland; 2026-08, the Saudia campaign running Uber Journey Ads programmatically, billed as a first for an airline in Saudi Arabia. The about page quotes a Forrester Wave assessment of its media operations practice; no case study text or job postings are on record.

Pricing: no signal; P5 unknown. Conspicuously absent for a performance network of this size: its own Google ads, a social pixel, an llms.txt, an owned audience line, and named clients beyond three.
clients:
The record describes an enterprise client type, two verticals, Travel & airlines and Banking, and offices across the US (Chicago, Miami, New York City), Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Spain, Poland, Ukraine, Romania, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, India, China, Australia, Brazil and Mexico, so the book holds 3 names: 1 observed, 2 names only, from 1 press release and 2 award entries.

Observed: Saudia Airlines, read as paid performance from the 2026-08 release on driving traveler engagement with Uber Ads, the programmatic Uber Journey Ads campaign. Names only: PrivatBank and E-ZOO, both surfaced by the 2026-07 post on the seven IAB MIXX Awards won by Performics Ukraine, with nothing in the record about the work, so their needs are inferred from the paid search, social and programmatic mix the agency leads with. The mix is a 1.0 share paid performance on the single observed entry. No client sits on another tracked agency's book (shared_n 0). The gap between the 1,000+ global clients claim and 3 names is the widest in this batch and is a compile result as much as a disclosure choice: the case study category page is a listed source, yet the record holds no case study text.

What the base needs next, read against KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out): airline and banking advertisers buying paid search and paid social hours from a holdco unit are likely, at moderate confidence, to push those hours into platform automation or in house teams, and the record shows Performics answering with OneSuite and Connected Feed (P4 and P2 making) rather than with pricing. Read against KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation), the same advertisers are likely to ask for AI answer visibility, where the record shows Microsoft research and no audited product.
house: Say and do: 1 of 3 tested lines practised, integrity 33.3. Paid search is contradicted, it sells paid search and the Transparency Center holds no Google ads of its own (the 1 matching ad belongs to another advertiser); paid social is contradicted, it sells paid social and runs no social ad pixel on its own site; LinkedIn advertising is corroborated by 1+ company page ads, the one sampled a Spanish language episode of #GameChangersbyPerformics. The Radar flags both contradictions as gaps. The site is small and slow: 93 sitemap URLs, 12 updated in 90 days and 25 in 365, no llms.txt, 2 AI topic URLs, no AI crawlers blocked. The stack is WordPress with ga4 and onetrust tags; no social pixels, test tools or ABM stack are detected, on a site selling identity powered planning. No Meta or TikTok reading exists and the only social link is LinkedIn.

openings:
The lead is the say/do gap on two of its five core lines. Performics sells paid search and paid social, and its own house shows no Google ads in the Transparency Center and no social pixel; a rival whose own media runs and whose own site measures is very likely, at high confidence, to make OneSuite look like a platform without a practitioner. The falsifier: a recompile showing Performics ads in the Transparency Center and a pixel on performics.com.

The exposure to press is KJ6: paid search and paid social hours are the sold core, resilience is 37.9, and the holdco parent reports to I8 in October 2026. An offer pricing those hours on outputs and outcomes, which Performics cannot answer in public (P5 unknown), is likely, at moderate confidence, to win a hearing with the airline and banking advertisers it names. Ads inside assistants are unclaimed (P8 absent). The observed hub footprint in Poland, Ukraine, Romania, India, Brazil and Mexico gives an onshore delivery pitch something to point at, though displacement at 38.6 says price alone is unlikely to move the book. Contestable names: PrivatBank and E-ZOO, award entries without described work.
watch: I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, reads in October 2026: output or outcome pricing announced at a top five holdco would move KJ6, the judgment Performics is most exposed to, and Publicis Groupe is one of the disclosures to read.
I4, Meta Q3 2026 average price per ad, reads in late October 2026: at or above +5% continues walled garden inflation and deepens the KJ5 exposure on its paid social and programmatic lines.

I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, reads next in late October 2026: search and other growth below 10% flags cannibalization, and above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, reads next in late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

Follow up the 2026-08 Saudia Uber Journey Ads campaign for published results and the 2025-06 Connected Feed launch for a named ecommerce client, either of which would add an observed need to a book of 3.
